words.prose: {{ar:جَهَنَّمَ}} ({{tr:jahannama}}) opens the ayah as the accusative name that specifies the prior phrase, the abode of ruin, across the 14:28->14:29 boundary. The accepted nominative variant exposes a possible independent-topic reading, but the local accusative keeps the canonical surface tied to the earlier construction (14:28). As a proper name, it is already a recognized destination, while the depth and abyss background gives the name spatial weight without turning it into a mere common noun. Its first-position beat prepares the sequence: named place, experienced fire exposure, then formal blame.

topics.headline: accusative boundary apposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins before the previous syntactic chain has fully closed: the named destination specifies the prior abode of ruin (14:28).
topics.reason: QAC allows accusative apposition to the prior phrase, while the nominative qiraat is retained as a structural contrast rather than made the canonical local parse.

topics.headline: proper name with depth pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word names a recognized punishment-domain while still carrying an engulfing depth image as secondary pressure.
topics.reason: V4 accepts the punishment-name branch and a depth branch, but the local QAC form is a proper noun, so depth and origin disputes qualify rather than replace the proper-name sense.

topics.headline: punishment formula prepared
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening name already belongs to a familiar punishment pattern that the final blame formula completes, with fire-action parallels such as 4:115, 38:56, and 58:8.
topics.reason: The rows point to recurring Jahannam pairings with the blame formula and the fire-exposure verb, including 4:115, 38:56, and 58:8, and the local ayah places those elements in immediate sequence.

topics.headline: place-name opens the frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah is framed by place-language: a named destination at the start and a settled abode at the end.
topics.reason: The local word order puts the destination before the action and verdict, and the final noun supplies the matching place-state closure.

words.prose: {{ar:يَصْلَوْنَهَا}} ({{tr:yaṣlawnahā}}) turns the named destination into lived exposure: the plural ending carries the prior actors forward from 14:28 without renaming them, and the suffix binds the action back to {{ar:جَهَنَّمَ}} ({{tr:jahannama}}). Its imperfect form makes the burning durative rather than a single completed point. The verb also specifies the abstract ruin from 14:28 as fire exposure and anticipates the fire-destination language of 14:30. The broad {{ar:ص ل ي}} ({{tr:ṣ-l-y}}) family includes prayer and beneficial warming, but this Form IV object frame selects destructive fire exposure; the emphatic {{ar:ص}} ({{tr:ṣād}}) opening gives that heat-contact a marked surface edge.

topics.headline: plural subject and object suffix compressed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the punished group and Jahannam are packed into the verb form, so consequence arrives without a repeated subject phrase.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify a 3mp imperfect with a feminine singular object suffix that resumes the named place.

topics.headline: durative Form IV fire exposure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the action is sustained exposure to the named fire-place, not mere arrival at a location.
topics.reason: The local form is imperfect Form IV with an object; V4 supports the fire-encounter branch, while self-benefactive warming, prayer, and reflexive exposure remain non-local contrasts.

topics.headline: middle action bridges place and verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the middle verb specifies ruin as fire exposure and gives the final blame verdict an experienced scene to judge.
topics.reason: The verb stands between the opening place-name and the closing blame formula, and the boundary rows tie abstract ruin backward and fire destination forward.

topics.headline: longer action beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the action beat is audibly more extended than the opening name, matching the ongoing exposure it describes.
topics.reason: The surface verb carries prefix, plural ending, and suffix, and the contextual profile keeps this occurrence in an active verbal lane.

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa-}}) is small but structurally loaded: it links the burning clause to the blame verdict, can relaunch the final clause after the pause, and can let the verdict overlay the scene as simultaneous evaluation. Because it is fused to {{ar:بِئْسَ}} ({{tr:biʾsa}}), the turn from experience to judgment is both connected and abrupt.

topics.headline: coordination and resumption both live
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final verdict is joined to the burning scene while also able to stand as a fresh pronouncement.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence allow coordination or new-discourse force for the clause beginning with the particle.

topics.headline: fused pivot into blame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the connector has no root-field of its own; its whole payoff is the immediate pivot into the blame verb.
topics.reason: The particle is rootless and proclitic, so its value is relational: it binds the transition and carries the listener into the verdict.

topics.headline: boundary continuity preserved
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that recitational boundaries do not sever the construction; they help stage description first and verdict second.
topics.reason: The rows tie the particle to the pause after the burning clause and to the larger cross-ayah chain.

words.prose: {{ar:بِئْسَ}} ({{tr:biʾsa}}) shifts the ayah from description to verdict. Its frozen past-shaped form is not narrating a past action; it performs dispraise, with {{ar:ٱلْقَرَارُ}} ({{tr:al-qarāru}}) as the definite subject of the blame formula and Jahannam recoverable as the understood target. The root field of misery and severity makes the verdict hard, and the hamza arrests the sound as the closure turns description into judgment. The accepted {{ar:وَبِيسَ}} ({{tr:wa-bīsa}}) reading keeps the same judgment with a smoother sound contour.

topics.headline: frozen performative blame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word is a formal act of condemnation, not a normal narrative verb.
topics.reason: QAC marks an uninflected blame verb, and attachment evidence makes the following definite noun its subject.

topics.headline: compressed recoverable target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the formula judges the destination without repeating the opening name, letting the named place and final noun converge.
topics.reason: The blame construction is complete with the definite subject, while the understood specified target is recoverable from the clause frame.

topics.headline: severity behind dispraise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verdict is not weak dislike; the misery sense is sharpened by the root-family field of severity.
topics.reason: V4 lacks this root in the bundle, so the severity branch is kept only as supplied CRITICAL/contextual pressure under the local dispraise form.

topics.headline: formula and qiraat contour
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verdict belongs to a recurring blame formula, including the 13:18 parallel, while the qiraat changes its acoustic landing without changing its force.
topics.reason: The rows supply formulaic parallels such as 13:18, while the hamza-smoothed reading is recitational contrast rather than a different construction.

topics.headline: description becomes assessment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final segment converts the prior name and burning action into an explicit settled judgment.
topics.reason: The blame verb begins the closing clause after the burning description and functions as the semantic terminus of the prior exchange (14:28).

words.gloss_range: the definite settling-place or settled state condemned by the blame formula; decision, comfort, low-place, and vessel branches remain secondary pressures
words.root_gloss_range: settling, remaining fixed, comfort/coolness, decision/acknowledgment, low-ground containment, and vessels; local gerund selects fixed abode/state
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْقَرَارُ}} ({{tr:al-qarāru}}) closes the ayah as the definite nominative subject of the blame formula: the settling-place itself bears the verdict. The root's fixedness makes the punishment sound like a state where movement stops, and the low-ground branch sharpens that as downward containment, while comfort and coolness branches reverse into irony because this rest is condemned. Decision and acknowledgment senses can pressure the word as settled outcome, but the preceding Jahannam-and-burning frame selects abode/state as the local parse; the glass-vessel branch gives only a contrastive containment image beside the paradise vessels of 76:15. Its last-word position makes fixed permanence the final landing point, echoing the no-settlement contrast at 14:26 and preparing the destination language at 14:30.

topics.headline: definite nominative blame subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final noun is not an incidental location; it is the grammatical bearer of the dispraise.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the noun as definite nominative and subject of the blame verb.

topics.headline: fixed abode and settled outcome
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word condemns a fixed abode/state, with outcome or decision pressure converging at the end but not replacing the place sense.
topics.reason: V4 supports settling/fixedness and acknowledgment branches, but the local gerund after Jahannam and fire exposure selects the abode/state lane as primary.

topics.headline: comfort branch reversed into irony
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the irony that a root family capable of comfort and coolness becomes the name of condemned fixation here.
topics.reason: The comfort/coolness branch is real in V4, but local context makes it ironic background under the condemned settlement sense.

topics.headline: gerund containment and form choice
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the chosen gerund makes broad fixed settlement primary while low-ground and glass-vessel containment sharpen the image only secondarily.
topics.reason: The local form is a GERUND, not an explicit Form X noun or a vessel form; the vessel contrast is useful only as a branch contrast, including the paradise-vessel reference at 76:15.

topics.headline: 14:26/14:30 fixedness echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah lands on fixed permanence, reversing the no-settlement image at 14:26 and linking into destination language at 14:30.
topics.reason: The word is final in the ayah, and the rows supply same-surah and boundary echoes from 14:26 and 14:30 that make fixedness the closing mechanism.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus joins fire-exposure to an explicitly blamed qarar.
baseline_models.mechanism: Meeting fire becomes durative and spatial through qarar: this is not passing contact but a fixed abode, and bi's pronounces that fixation wretched.

activation_trace.role: Meeting fire and its heat supplies the bodily exposure.
Fixity turns exposure into an enduring located condition.
The formula of blame supplies the verdict on that condition.

changed_reading.before: They enter Hell, which is a bad destination.
changed_reading.after: They continually meet fire as their fixed dwelling, and the clause condemns that very fixation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The hot encounter is called a qarar.
baseline_models.mechanism: Qarar carries coldness and the quieted eye, but here it is coupled to heat and aversion. The phrase constructs an anti-rest: settlement whose sensory and affective content defeats repose.

activation_trace.role: Fire-contact supplies the thermal pole opposed to cool repose.
Coldness supplies the thermal expectation inverted by fire.
The quieted eye supplies the affective expectation of settled relief.
Sorrow and aversion negate that expected relief.

changed_reading.before: Qarar merely labels where they remain.
changed_reading.after: Qarar is bitterly inverted: expected cool, quiet rest is fixed as heat and aversion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus roots can form a process from heating through force to fixation.
baseline_models.mechanism: Fire that straightens material combines with overpowering severity and final fixity, yielding a coercive furnace-process rather than only a container.

activation_trace.role: Heating and straightening by fire supplies a material process.
Overpowering severity supplies coercive force.
Fixity supplies the set end-state produced by heat.

changed_reading.before: Hell is a location containing punitive fire.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, Hell is also a furnace-process whose overpowering heat fixes a condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The tree sequence opposes sound rooted stability to an evil word uprooted wholesale and possessing no qarar; the next movement gives wrongdoers a qarar in Hell. Qarar becomes punitive reversal: denied truthful rootedness becomes terminal placement.

activation_trace.role: The good tree's endurance supplies positive stability.
Whole-root extraction removes every stable hold.
Denied settlement makes the focus occurrence a marked reversal.
Divine strengthening supplies the positive agentive counterpart.
The focus reintroduces settlement as a punitive endpoint.

structural_cues: 14:24-27 places fixed root, total uprooting, no qarar, and divine fixing in one sequence.
14:28-29 immediately follows with the abode of ruin and Hell.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed fixities and repeats q-r-r; I infer a reversal from failed rootedness to punitive placement. Alternatively, both occurrences may be ordinary spatial language without a causal relation.

changed_reading.before: Hell is simply a lasting abode.
changed_reading.after: Those without truthful rootedness receive a qarar only as the terminal fixation answering their lack of stable ground.

context_deltas.mechanism: Dependents call themselves followers; actors then cause their people to lodge in an abode of ruin, and the destination is named as fire. The plural occupants are socially delivered into a shared settlement: leadership becomes place-making.

activation_trace.role: Trailing supplies the social dependency whose endpoint is at issue.
Caused lodging supplies the action placing a people in the abode.
Residence in a dar supplies the habitation frame.
Ruin specifies the quality of that abode.
Becoming toward an outcome confirms fire as the reached end.
Plural fire-contact realizes the collective destination bodily.

structural_cues: 14:21 stages followers and arrogant leaders together without escape.
14:28 causatively lodges a people, 14:29 names Hell, and 14:30 restates the fire destination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies following, causative lodging, a communal object, and destination; I infer that leadership converts allegiance into collective habitation. Alternatively, the verses may identify one group without foregrounding social transport.

changed_reading.before: Plural subjects merely share a punishment.
changed_reading.after: Their shared fire-abode is socially produced: leaders lodge a people in ruin and followers arrive with them.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the focus, ṣ-l-w/ṣ-l-y recurs three times as established prayer. This creates an embodied contrast between a freely maintained orientation and compulsory fire-exposure: two sustained relations rather than momentary acts.

activation_trace.role: Upright standing supplies the maintained bodily posture.
Specific worship supplies the first counter-domain to fire.
Prayer in the settlement scene links maintained practice to constructive habitation.
The prayer to remain an establisher emphasizes continuity.
The focus supplies compulsory fire-contact against maintained worship.

structural_cues: 14:31 follows the fire destination and commands established prayer before a day without exchange.
14:37 and 14:40 repeat established prayer within Abraham's settlement prayer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies split mapped roots with fire and worship branches plus repeated q-w-m constructions; I infer an experiential contrast. Alternatively, the morphological echo may be incidental.

changed_reading.before: The focus verb denotes only entering or feeling fire.
changed_reading.after: It can be heard as the coerced, sustained counterpart to a freely established bodily orientation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Elsewhere settlement is built from granted land, a secure city, a family placed by a house, and inherited dwellings that should teach. Against these scenes, bi's al-qarar is an anti-home: fixity stripped of safety, purpose, and shelter.

activation_trace.role: Granted land-settlement supplies positive inhabitation.
Safety's inner quiet supplies the quality absent from the focus.
A bounded city supplies the civic container requested as secure.
Placing descendants supplies purposeful family settlement.
The house supplies a protected center for worship and provision.
Prior wrongdoers' dwellings supply failed inherited habitation.
The focus retains fixity while removing the goods of home.

structural_cues: 14:35-37 combines secure city, descendants, house, prayer, hearts, and provision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies constructive and failed dwellings; I infer that the focus is their privative inversion, a home reduced to inescapable location. Alternatively, qarar may mark duration alone.

changed_reading.before: Hell is bad because it is permanent residence.
changed_reading.after: Hell is the anti-home: permanent placement retains settlement's shell while negating safety, shelter, and sustaining purpose.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier Hell imagery blocks swallowing and lets death approach without completing death; the groups have no escape, and later a claim of no cessation is recalled. Qarar fixes a process that repeatedly refuses release.

activation_trace.role: Drinking supplies an imposed bodily process.
Smooth throat-passage is approached but blocked.
Loss of life is invoked and negated, withholding an endpoint.
Deviation supplies the escape route the speakers lack.
Removal from a state supplies the mobility wrongly denied.
Fixity gathers blocked completion and absent escape.

structural_cues: 14:16-17 presents Hell as unfinished bodily ordeal.
14:21 makes panic and patience equally unable to produce exit.
14:44 asks for delay only when punishment arrives.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies blocked endpoints; I infer that qarar fixes subjects inside recursive noncompletion. Alternatively, each detail may independently intensify punishment.

changed_reading.before: Permanent abode means remaining alive in one place.
changed_reading.after: The qarar is fixed nonrelease: swallowing, death, and escape all fail to complete.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing tableau pairs bodies, fastens them, clothes them in pitch, and lets fire cover faces. Restraint enacts qarar mechanically while fire becomes garment and face-covering rather than external scenery.

activation_trace.role: Binding one thing to another supplies collective immobilization.
Shackling gives settlement a restraint mechanism.
Clothing supplies the bodily interface for burning material.
Flowing pitch supplies a clinging heat-bearing layer.
General envelopment moves fire across exposed surface.
The face locates covering at the organ of encounter.
Blazing fire identifies the covering agent.
The focus fire-contact becomes intimate bodily contact.

structural_cues: 14:49-50 moves from paired prisoners to shackles, garments, pitch, faces, and covering fire.
The sequence closes distance in stages: pairing, fastening, clothing, then envelopment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies binding, clothing, pitch, and covering fire; I infer that these jointly enact settlement by erasing the occupant-place boundary. Alternatively, they may be independent punishments.

changed_reading.before: They remain inside a fire external to their bodies.
changed_reading.after: Their abode closes onto the body: binding prevents departure, burning material becomes clothing, and fire occupies the face-to-world boundary.

context_deltas.mechanism: A matter is decided, blessing is exchanged for disbelief, and every self is repaid for what it earned through swift accounting. Bi's al-qarar becomes an account-closing verdict: an exchange has become an earned, enforced outcome.

activation_trace.role: Cutting judgment supplies procedural closure.
Substitution supplies the exchange preceding the abode.
Act-matched recompense supplies the return relation.
Acquisition supplies what is attributed to each self.
Accounting supplies the settlement procedure.
Establishing a fact supplies settled liability.

structural_cues: 14:22 distributes responsibility after the matter is decided.
14:28 exchanges blessing for disbelief immediately before the focus.
14:51 joins individual recompense, acquisition, and accounting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies decision, exchange, acquisition, recompense, and accounting; I infer an arrow from exchange to settled liability. Alternatively, qarar may remain purely locative.

changed_reading.before: The focus reports and evaluates a place.
changed_reading.after: The place is also a settled account: the ruinous exchange returns as individually earned liability.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The racing sense of ṣ-l-y is form-distant and cannot replace the fire sense. It remains anchored in the focus root and activated by explicit following, lodging, and destination language; render it only as a social-spatial echo.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The branch in which the second racer follows the leader is latent in the focus verb.

activation_trace.role: The racer behind the leader supplies consequential following.
Trailing supplies the explicit social relation.
Caused lodging supplies delivery to the endpoint.
Becoming toward an outcome supplies the terminus.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the plural entry is the last stage of social following: followers arrive behind leaders at the same endpoint.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Settlement surviving replacement of earth is conceptually surprising but anchored in focus qarar and packet-local uprooting, ground, substitution, and overpowering. Render it as spatial paradox, not afterlife geography.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus promises fixity although the surah destabilizes ordinary ground.

activation_trace.role: Fixity supplies the apparently stable spatial claim.
Root-extraction destroys ordinary groundedness.
Substitution removes the familiar ground-system.
Earth supplies the lower ground that ordinary residence requires.
Overpowering supplies imposed fixity independent of familiar terrain.

changed_reading.before: Qarar is a stable place on stable ground.
changed_reading.after: The wretched qarar is groundless fixity: even exchanged earth cannot release subjects from the imposed relation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This material analogy crosses distant q-h-r and q-t-r branch images. It remains anchored in the focus's own fire-straightening and fixing branches and is sharpened by covering fire; label it exploratory, not literal anatomy or metallurgy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus fire branch can straighten material while qarar names a set state.

activation_trace.role: Fire used to straighten supplies the kiln-like operation.
Fixity supplies the set condition.
Material altered by fire supplies a distant transformation image.
Molten copper supplies a liquid-hot material analogy.
Envelopment supplies full-surface exposure.

changed_reading.before: Fire punishes occupants while remaining their surroundings.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, fire behaves like a kiln: it envelops, materially acts, and fixes a condition.

strongest_changes: The no-qarar tree sequence turns the focus into reversal from rootlessness to punitive fixation.
Secure city, settled family, house, and inherited dwellings recast Hell as an anti-home.
Shackles, pitch garments, and face-covering fire make qarar bodily through restraint and envelopment.
Decision, exchange, earning, recompense, and accounting let the abode function as closed liability.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah cues repeatedly destabilized and rebuilt settlement through roots, homes, leadership, prayer, blocked death, changed earth, restraint, and accounting, allowing several mechanisms to coexist.
remaining_uncertainties: The prayer/fire relation crosses supplied ṣ-l-w and ṣ-l-y mappings and may be echo rather than governing mechanism.
The follower-race and kiln readings are deliberately branch-distant.
Qarar may foreground duration, imposed placement, lost repose, or judicial closure without one sense canceling the others.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **The terminal dwelling is both encounter with heat and a condemned settlement.** `ص ل ي` `B003` gives encountering fire/heat, while `ق ر ر` `B003` gives fixed remaining and `ب ء س` `B004` the blame formula. The preceding *dar al-bawar* and following destination language turn a moment of burning into habitation. I infer repeated policy has become place; the ayah reads as an adverse settlement produced by prior lodging of the people.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The immediately following destination statement in 14:30 corrected any event-only reading of fire: repeated policy has become a terminal place of becoming.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The destination is an anti-ecological encounter with heat.** `ص ل ي B003` supplies encountering fire and its heat. The preceding word-tree has lost its root and the following ayah names fire, while 14:32-34 supply the counter-system of water, fruit, rivers, cycles, and gifts. The packet supplies two opposed material environments; I infer that fire is the medium of a nonproductive ecology. `يَصْلَوْنَهَا` reads as sustained exposure to that environment, not a momentary crossing.
2. **The only settlement produced by uprooting is punitive settlement.** `ق ر ر B003` supplies settling and remaining fixed. The foul tree in 14:26 had no `قَرَار`, and 14:28 says leaders settled their people in ruin; this ayah then names hell itself `ٱلْقَرَار`. The packet supplies the lexical reversal; I infer that rejected rootedness is replaced by forced fixation at the destructive endpoint. `بِئْسَ ٱلْقَرَار` is therefore a bitter resolution of the stability motif.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 14:32-34 retrospectively supplied the material counter-environment of water, fruit, rivers, cycles, and innumerable favor. That later abundance made `يَصْلَوْنَهَا` read as exposure to an anti-ecology rather than heat in isolation.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü ateşe girme, ateşte kalma, ısısını ve şiddetini çekme ile birini ateşe sokma ilişkilerini birlikte destekler; benzer biçimde ağır bir duruma uğrama da buna bağlı bir uzantıdır. Dal, ateşle nesne pişirme veya düzeltme eyleminden ayrıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam ateş ya da ateşe benzetilen ağır durumla kurulan yapılara bağlıdır; yalın ve sınırsız bir kök anlamı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca ateş, ısı veya benzetilen ağır durumla kurulan yapılara bağlanır ve yalın köke genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Ateşe girip onda kalmak, ısısını ve şiddetini çekmek ya da bir başkasını ateşe sokmaktır; benzetmeli kullanımda ağır bir durumun sıkıntısını çekmeyi anlatır.

facets.statement: Ateşe girmek, onda kalmak ve yakıcı şiddetine uğramaktır.
Bir başkasını ateşe sokup bu şiddete uğratmaktır.
Ateşe benzetilen ağır bir işin veya kötülüğün sıkıntısını çekmektir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ateşin içine girme, onda kalma ve yakıcı şiddetini çekme çekirdeğinde birleşir; ettirgen kullanım bir başkasını ateşe sokar, benzetmeli kullanım ise ağır sıkıntıya uğramayı anlatır.

concept_gloss.text: ateşin veya benzer bir sıkıntının şiddetine uğramak; birini ateşe sokmak
concept_gloss.applicability: Ateşle kurulan edilgen, ettirgen ve benzetmeli yapıların ortak anlam alanını kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: Ateşe girme, şiddetini çekme, başkasını ateşe sokma ve ağır sıkıntı uzantısını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin ateşe girdiği, onda kaldığı veya yandığı doğrudan bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Ateşle doğrudan karşılaşmayı, içinde kalmayı ve yakıcı şiddeti çekmeyi korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ateş benzetmesiyle ağır bir işin veya kötülüğün çekildiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yakıcı şiddetin ağır sıkıntıya aktarılan benzetmeli uzantısını korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: onun sertliğini ve gücünü göze alamamak

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da ateşle karşılaşmayı, yakıcı sıcaklığı çekmeyi ve bundan doğan ağır durumu kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal ateşin şiddetine uğrayan veya uğratılan katılımcıya bağlı yapılardır; komşu dal ise ateşin yakıt ve pişirme işlevlerini de kapsadığı için daha geniştir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü ateşi canlandıran yakıtı, ateşte pişmiş yiyeceği, eti ateşte pişirmeyi ve değneği ateş üzerinde döndürerek düzeltmeyi açıkça bir araya getirir. Bunlar ateşin şiddetine uğramaktan farklı olarak ateşten yararlanılan nesne ve işlemlerdir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yalın yakıt ve pişmiş yiyecek adları, eti pişirme ve değneği düzeltme yapılarından ayrı facetler olarak tutulur.

Bir değneği ateş üzerinde döndürerek yumuşatıp düzeltme işlemidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, ateşi besleyen yakıtı ve ateşten yararlanarak yiyecek pişirme ya da değnek düzeltme işlemlerini kapsar; ateşe uğrayan kişinin yaşantısını anlatmaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Değneğin ateş üstünde döndürülerek biçiminin düzeltildiği yapıyı açıklar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi ateşin sıcaklığına maruz kalmayı, ateş yanında ısınmayı, bir şeyi ateşle pişirip yakmayı, ateşe atmayı, yakacağı ve zorluğa katlanma aktarımını birlikte doğrular.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Ateşle doğrudan karşılaşma çekirdektir; pişirme, yakma, düzeltme, yakacak ve zorluğa katlanma kullanımları ayrı tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın biçimlerin ateş ve yakacak anlamlarını korurken yalnız belirli kuruluşlarda görülen ısınma, düzeltme ve zorluğa katlanma anlamlarını genelleştirmez.

concept_map.definition: Ateşin içine girerek ya da yanında bulunarak onun yakıcı sıcaklığına maruz kalmayı anlatır; ateşte eti pişirme ile değneği ateşte yumuşatıp düzeltme gibi ateşle işleme anlamları belirli kuruluşlara bağlıdır. Ateşi besleyen yakacak adı ile bir işin ağır sıkıntısını çekme anlamı bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Bir varlık ateşe girer, ateşin yanında kalır veya onun yakıcı sıcaklığını ve şiddetini çeker.
Kişi ateşin yanında durarak onun sıcaklığıyla ısınır.
Belirli kuruluşlarda et ateşte pişirilir veya değnek ateşte yumuşatılıp düzeltilir.
Ad biçimi ateşi tutuşturup sürdürmeye yarayan yakacağı, ayrıca ateşte pişirme işini belirtebilir.
Ateşin yakıcılığı, bir işin ağırlığını ve sıkıntısını çekmeye aktarılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi düz ve pürüzsüz zemin, alçak ya da yuvarlak tabanlı arazi ve kabın dibine yapışan kalıntıyı aynı dalda toplar. Verilen çerçeve bunları dip ve yerleşme görüntüsüyle bağlayabilir, ancak tek bir arazi türü veya tek bir nesne anlamı gibi sunulmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, arazi biçimleri ile kap dibi kalıntısını ayrı yüzler olarak korur; genel yerleşme eylemine genişletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım kanıtlanan çıplak ad biçimlerini kapsar; düz zemin, çukur taban ve kap tortusu birbirine indirgenmez.

concept_map.definition: Düz ve pürüzsüz bir zemin, alçak ya da yuvarlak tabanlı bir arazi kesimi ve bir kabın dibine yerleşip yapışan kalıntı için kullanılan yakın biçimli adları kapsar.

facets.statement: Düz, pürüzsüz ve açık zemin bir temel arazi görünümüdür.
Alçak, çukur veya yuvarlak tabanlı arazi kesimi ayrı bir yer biçimi olarak adlandırılır.
Bir kabın en altına yerleşip yapışan tortu veya kalıntı da dip ilişkisiyle adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar düz ve pürüzsüz zemin ile alçak veya yuvarlak tabanlı araziyi birlikte kaydeder. Yakın bir biçim ayrıca kabın dibine yapışan kalıntıyı gösterir; arazi ile tortu yüzleri ayrı tutulmalıdır.

concept_gloss.text: düz taban, çukur taban ve dip tortusu

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi inkârın karşıtı olarak bir şeyi kabul edip doğrulamayı, hakkı kendisi aleyhine tanımayı, başkasını kabule yöneltmeyi ve bir sözü ya da işi sabitleyip açıklamayı birlikte verir. Dal çerçevesi bu geçişli ve ettirgen yönleri doğru biçimde kapsar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Mekânda yerleşme yalnızca tarihsel açıklama olabilir; bu dalın doğrudan anlamı kabul, doğrulama ve sabitlemedir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım genel kabul ve doğrulama çekirdeğini, hakka ilişkin kalıp ile ettirgen açıklama ve sabitleme kullanımlarından ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi inkâr etmeyip doğru veya kendisi için bağlayıcı sayarak kabul etmeyi, bir kişiyi böyle bir kabule yöneltmeyi ve bir söz ya da işi açıklayıp sabit hâle getirmeyi anlatır.

facets.statement: Bir şey inkâr edilmez; doğru veya bağlayıcı olduğu kabul edilip doğrulanır.
Kişi, kendisiyle ilgili bir hakkı veya yükümlülüğü açıkça tanıyıp kabul eder.
Bir başkası kabule yöneltilir ya da bir söz ve iş açıklanarak sabit bir duruma getirilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar inkâr etmeme, kabul ve doğrulamayı ortak çekirdek olarak verir. Hakkı kendi üzerinde tanıma, birini kabule yöneltme ve sözü ya da işi açıklayıp sabitleme bu çekirdeğin belirgin kullanımlarıdır.

concept_gloss.text: kabul edip doğrulamak ve sabitlemek

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal tekil kişi adını yerleşik yaşamla ilişkilendirir ve özellikle terziyi gösterebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Karşı dal çamur, kazı ve benzeri işlerde çalışan işçi topluluğunu ve ayrıca marangozu kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal emek veya zanaat işi yapan kişileri adlandırabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Karşı dal işçi topluluğu ve belirli başka meslekler çevresindedir; bu dal yerleşik zanaatkâr ve özellikle terzi adıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal kişiyi mesleği veya yerleşik yaşam biçimiyle adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Karşı dal hizmet etme eylemini, işte ustalığı ve hizmetçi konumunu birlikte kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal düzenli çalışma, beceri ve iş yapan kişi alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal bir kişi sınıfının adıdır; karşı dalın çekirdeği hizmet ve işte beceri olup yerleşik yaşam şartı taşımaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal yerleşik kişiyi zanaat veya kent yaşamı üzerinden sınıflandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Karşı dal bir yerde hiç ayrılmadan kalma eylemini ve aynı yerde yaz kış kalan kuşları anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da göçmeme ve bir yerde sürekli kalma düşüncesi vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Karşı dal doğrudan kalma eylemidir; bu dal kalıcı yaşamın meslek veya kentlilikle birleştiği kişi adıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sözcüğü doğrudan kuşun yemi biriktiren kursağı olarak açıklar ve onu benzer bir organ adıyla eşler. Dal çerçevesi bu organı yerleşim yeri anlamındaki benzer sesli sözcükten doğru biçimde ayırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Gösterilen, kuşun sindirim sistemindeki besin kesesidir; yerleşim yeri veya genel boğaz organı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca kanıtlanan çıplak organ adını verir ve bunu kasaba, bağırsak ya da başka boğaz yapılarına genişletmez.

concept_map.definition: Kuşun yuttuğu besinin sindirimden önce toplandığı ve geçici olarak biriktiği kese biçimindeki organdır.

facets.statement: Organ kuşun sindirim yolunda yer alan kese biçimli kursaktır.
Yutulan besin bu kesede toplanır ve bir süre tutulur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar sözcüğü kuşun kursağı olarak aynı biçimde açıklar ve besinin bu keseye atılması anlatımıyla organın toplama işlevini doğrular.

concept_gloss.text: kuş kursağı
concept_gloss.applicability: Organın ait olduğu canlıyı ve Türkçedeki yerleşik anatomik adını doğrudan karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Kuşun besin biriktiren kese biçimli sindirim organını eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir yiyeceğin kuşun besin toplayan kesesine gönderilmesi anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Besinin kuşun kursağında toplanması işlevini doğal bir eylem bağlamında korur.
error_profile.loses: Organın bağımsız anatomik tanımını tek başına vermez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal yalnızca organın belirli bir adı ve besin toplama işleviyle sınırlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal kuşta besinin biriktiği kese biçimli organı aynı referent olarak gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Organ çekirdeği ortaktır; karşı dal daha geniş türev ve adlandırmaları içerirken bu dal tek bir organ biçiminin söz varlığına bağlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal doğrudan kuşun kursağını adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Karşı dal geviş getiren hayvanın geri çıkardığı lokmayı, geviş getirme eylemini ve kursak için kullanılan başka bir biçimi birlikte kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Karşı dalın bir alt kullanımında aynı kursak organı yer alır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal yalnızca organdır; karşı dalın çekirdeği geviş ve yeniden çiğneme sürecine uzandığı için tam eşdeğer değildir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal sindirimden önce besinin toplandığı kuş kursağıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Karşı dal bağırsakları ve bazı aktarılmış yiyecek adlarını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal sindirim sistemindeki iç organları adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Kursak besini geçici olarak depolayan ön kesedir; bağırsak ise sindirimin sonraki bölümündeki farklı organdır.
